# Xodus Nexus 0.3.1

- Add **Manage content** for installing and repairing licensed PC add-ons and campaign packages.
- Show ownership, Game Pass access and installation status separately, with full content titles and download sizes.
- Keep content downloads in the Install Queue with pause, resume and retry support.

Update the Nexus runtime in Settings to use related content. For an existing game, select **Manage content** and install its missing licensed packages, then restart the game.
